title: Reports
subtitle: Reports from your scan results. Save as PDF or download the data as JSON or CSV.

meta.firstScan: First scan: there is nothing to compare it with.
meta.range: From the scan of {{from}} to the scan of {{to}}
meta.safety: Built from data the scanner already collected. Generating a report sends nothing to the hosts.

hub.scanDescription: Pick a scan, then the report you need.
hub.diffDescription: Compare any two scans, not only a scan with the one before it.
hub.ipDescription: The address in every scan: status, services and how they changed.
hub.historyDescription: Hosts that come and go, and hosts that depend on the time of day.

summary.title: Post-scan summary
summary.description: Execution, results, changes, top findings, ports, technologies and triage.

findings.title: Interesting findings
findings.description: Exposed databases, admin panels, TLS, cookies and headers, with a priority per host.

technologies.title: Technologies and CMSs
technologies.description: What runs where, with versions, confidence and groups of similar services.

exposure.title: Port exposure
exposure.description: How many hosts expose each port, and where the live hosts are.

triage.title: Triage progress
triage.description: Reviewed services, new ones nobody looked at, and remediation dates.

tags.title: Hosts by tag
tags.description: A summary of every tag, and the hosts carrying the one you pick.

diff.title: Changes between scans
diff.description: New, gone and changed hosts and services, with the values before and after.

stability.title: Unstable hosts
stability.description: Hosts that come and go, stop answering or should be reported as inactive.

timeOfDay.title: Time of day
timeOfDay.description: Hosts and ports that answer only in some parts of the day.

rules.debug-or-staging: Debug, staging or API documentation exposed
rules.cleartext-protocol: Cleartext protocol or login over HTTP
rules.remote-access: Remote access service (RDP, VNC, SMB, WinRM)

summary.phases: Time per phase, summed over jobs

findings.scoreHint: Priority adds up severity weights (high 10, medium 5, low 2, info 0.5), plus 3 for each new service, times 1.5 for hosts or services triaged important. False positives are left out.

technologies.confidenceHint: Confidence: high means two or more independent sources agree, medium one explicit source (service detection, a header or a generator tag), low only a cookie, title or path.

triage.progressHint: {{percent}} of the scan's services have a verdict.

tags.noTags: No host or service in this scan has a tag yet.

diff.noChanges: Both scans saw the same hosts and services.

ip.noAsset: The address has not answered in any scan, so there is no asset for it yet.

stability.inactiveAfter: Inactive after this many down answers
stability.none: No host was unstable in these scans.
stability.needScans: At least two scans with results are needed.

hints.flapping: Up and not up more than once in the window.
hints.unresponsive: Was up; the latest scans got no answer at all (timeout or not scanned).
hints.inactive: Answered down in each of the latest scans: report it as inactive.
hints.going-quiet: Answered down lately, but not yet often enough to count as inactive.
hints.unstable-ports: Up throughout, but some ports opened and closed more than once.
hints.returned: Answers again after a period without an answer.

timeOfDay.timezone: Parts of the day in your time zone (UTC{{offset}}).
timeOfDay.notComparable: All the compared scans ran in the same part of the day. Schedule scans at different hours to see differences.
timeOfDay.periodPorts: Ports in some parts of the day only
timeOfDay.none: No host depends on the time of day.
